snippet.title: Nubs! Arena | Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Nubs! Arena! is launching on May 15th 2025 on Steam and will be FREE TO KEEP the first 24 hours. Wishlist now to get a notification when the game is out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337860/Nubs_Arena/?utm_source=Youtube&utm_id=rdrt

Nubs! is played with you friends (or enemies) in lightning-quick PvP battles. Take control of a Nub and smash everyone to nublivion with many different pickups and abilities.

Follow Nubs! for updates:
X (Twitter) - https://twitter.com/FollowNubs
Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/playnubs.bsky.social
Discord - https://discord.gg/nubs
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@Nubs_game
